title: At Virginia Theological Seminary today
excerpt: Today I have the honor of delivering the commencement address and receiving an honorary doctorate at VTS. I’ve had the chance to get to know a lot of the students and faculty there, and so I savor this experience all the more. The celebration starts at 10 a.m. (Eastern time),…
body: Today I have the honor of delivering the commencement address and receiving an honorary doctorate at VTS. I’ve had the chance to get to know a lot of the students and faculty there, and so I savor this experience all the more. The celebration starts at 10 a.m. (Eastern time), and I understand it will be streamed live here.
